description: This file contains UI automation functions for benchmarking and testing the 'For You' feature in the Now in Android app, including waiting for content, selecting topics, scrolling the feed, and setting the app theme.

methods.name: forYouWaitForContent
methods.description: Waits for the 'For You' content to load by checking loading indicator and topic selection element.

methods.name: forYouSelectTopics
methods.description: Selects multiple topics in the 'For You' section, with optional rechecking of already checked topics.

methods.name: forYouScrollFeedDownUp
methods.description: Performs a scroll down and up gesture on the feed list.

methods.name: setAppTheme
methods.description: Sets the app theme to dark or light mode based on the parameter.
